scope: Fool Standard A10, v0.113.1, both bosses and natural terminal settlement

historical.screen: At least three pairs improve lexicographic (victory, reaches second boss, second-boss entry HP or first-boss exit HP), with no fewer natural wins. Record ties. A locally improved card is a candidate, not an estimated full-run win rate.

holdout.preparation: Candidate materials and planned changes must be frozen before inspecting any held-out outcomes. Controls may run early. Never use this cohort to tune the candidate.
holdout.gate: At least 12/20 natural victories in candidate and at least 2 more paired victories than unchanged. Report each result, Wilson 95% intervals and exact paired discordance test. This is a screening threshold, not proof of an underlying 60% rate.

eligibility: A native victory or defeat archived in the declared run. Record technical failures separately; retry only an interrupted arm on the same seed with unchanged materials. Preserve original artifacts and record any protocol amendment before unblinding.
